hostAdapters.notes: Web path: npm run arcsweep:deploy:server stages the build to starwell-server/public/arcsweep/ with __hearthgateHost injection. Native IPC path: window.arcsweep exposed in Hearthgate preload; handlers registered via registerArcsweepIpc in starwell-server/electron/main.js; storage.js detects window.arcsweep as host bridge. Single-writer lock (step 5) is pending.

lifecycle.launchStandalone: Launch Hearthgate Arcsweep from the Start Menu or desktop shortcut.
lifecycle.enableInHost: Connect the optional Arkfire adapter after standalone verification.
lifecycle.pause: Close the window; state is already persisted.
lifecycle.disableInHost: Disconnect the optional host adapter without stopping the standalone app.
lifecycle.uninstallStandalone: Use Windows Apps settings. Local data is preserved by default.
lifecycle.restore: Reinstall, then restore an exported archive or a local recovery snapshot.
